utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still able to help with the repair drive. I’m free this afternoon—what time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: This afternoon works—come by around 2 if that’s okay. I can use help sorting the tools and keeping the boxes straight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll be there around 2 and help sort the tools and keep the boxes straight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, mostly hands to sort tools and carry donations, I think. I always mix up the boxes, so keeping things in order would be a big relief.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll swing by later and help keep the tools and donations sorted. I’ll check what they’re short on and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—that’d be a big help. I’ll keep the coffee warm and try not to mix up the boxes again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks for checking in — a wrench and screwdriver would help most for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll spread the word and bring the tool list, including a wrench and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. I’m a little scattered, so that tool list will really help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can bring by a wrench and screwdriver later today. If you need anything else for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be great, Gus. Let’s keep it simple — bring the wrench and screwdriver, and I’ll make a clear list if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver later today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn — I’m just waiting on Faye’s message after pickup, then we can lock in the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll start spreading the word now and send anyone with questions your way. Just let me know as soon as Faye’s message comes through.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Quinn — I’ll let you know right away once Faye messages me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got the Saturday community center part confirmed, but I’m still checking the exact drop-off time. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — just let me know the exact drop-off time when you hear back, and I’ll keep the supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’m checking on it now, and I’ll pass along the exact time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful — I’ll send out the schedule and make sure everyone knows where to go and what to bring. Thanks for helping spread the word and bringing the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll check our supplies and see what we can bring to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Cleo — thank you. I’ll keep the schedule updated and we’ll be all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps a lot. I’ll wait for your update on the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — I’ll let you know the drop-off time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — let’s go through it together so I make sure I’ve got the list right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — let’s check it together and make sure we’ve got every item right.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — could you remind me of the items on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m on it — I’ll listen for any word about the trucks or who’s handling check-in. If I hear something useful, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — that’d help a lot. I’m just hoping the trucks keep coming and the check-in stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open for any truck updates or check-in news and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still handling the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’m still at school pickup, but I’ll message you right after and we can lock in the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just ping me when you’re free, and we’ll lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can head over whenever you’re ready and take the supplies from the shed to the church basement.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, Sam — are you still handling the repair drive list? I’m checking off what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’m still on the repair drive list. I can help check off what’s left.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
